title: Add background music to homepage with working volume control

requirements.text: Add background music audio file that plays faintly on the homepage when the page loads

quotes: I do want music playing faintly when on the website

acceptanceCriteria: Background music plays automatically when homepage loads
Music volume is set to a low, non-intrusive level by default
Music loops continuously while user remains on homepage

requirements.text: Connect the existing volume icon in the header to control the homepage background music playback state

quotes: Please fix that button so music plays when in the homepage of my website

acceptanceCriteria: Volume icon correctly reflects playing/muted state of background music
Clicking volume icon toggles music playback on/off
Volume icon state persists across page navigation within the site
Volume icon shows unmuted state when music is playing

requirements.text: Ensure background music only plays on the homepage and stops when navigating to other pages

quotes: music plays when in the homepage of my website

acceptanceCriteria: Music starts playing when user lands on homepage
Music stops or pauses when user navigates away from homepage
Music resumes when user returns to homepage if not manually muted

constraints: Use the existing useMusicPlayer hook and music toggle functionality in Header.tsx
Background music must be subtle and not interfere with user experience
Respect browser autoplay policies and handle autoplay restrictions gracefully
nonGoals: Adding music to pages other than the homepage
Implementing a full music playlist or multiple tracks
Creating a custom audio player UI with progress bars or track selection
